## Checklist

### All PRs

- [ ] I have self-reviewed my own code
- [ ] Tests are added or updated and pass locally
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed
- [ ] A changeset / changelog entry is added (if this affects the published package)

### UI changes (skip if not applicable)

- [ ] All variants and states are covered (default, hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error)
- [ ] Keyboard navigation and focus management verified
- [ ] Accessibility checks pass (axe, screen reader spot-check, color contrast)
- [ ] Responsive behavior verified across breakpoints
- [ ] Works with all themes / dark mode
- [ ] Storybook stories added or updated
- [ ] Visual regression snapshots reviewed

### New atom / molecule / component (skip if not applicable)

- [ ] Exported from the package index
- [ ] Every item in the tracking issue's definition of done is complete
